purpose: Discover changes before objectively defined breakout hours, turn discovery into hypotheses, replicate without retuning
universe: Same36 fixed coins from flow_replay. Reuse cached hourly and5min spot trade data. No extra downloads or asset substitution.
event: Anchor t is beginning of breakout hour: close(t+1h)/close(t)>=1.05 and maximum high in next24h>=1.15*close(t). Before t, every hourly close return in past6h<3% and cumulative6h return<5%. Contiguous30day candles and trailing30day turnover200k..20M at t. Keep earliest anchor per coin then24h event refractory period. No hindsight trough/minimum selection. This is a coarse hourly onset proxy, not the exact first price movement.
features: Six causal hourly features: quote1h / baseline mean quote; trades1h / baseline mean trades; average quote/trade1h / baseline average quote/trade; net buy fraction1h minus baseline net buy fraction; normalized hourly range / baseline mean range; last1h return minus preceding3h mean return. Baseline is prior18h ending6h before each observation. Ratio scores are log ratios. Include RPI and assume archived side follows Bybit taker convention.
eligibility: Same past30day liquidity200k..20M and quiet6h gate for all observations. Raw daily files for past24h complete,>=80% active5min bins, firstbin active, last trade<=5min old, quote sum within1% of hourly turnover. Do not impose future case quality when labeling real-time observations.
discovery: Apr2..Jun29 23UTC; require label end beforeJul1. Three same-hour controls with no15% high rise over next24h, matched by liquidity,7day volatility and24h return at t-6h using discovery-only scaling. Max standardized distance3. All four trajectories require quality at offsets -24,-12,-6,-3,-2,-1,0h. Failed match removed as whole set.
selection: Only inspect discovery results first. For each six score, infer direction from matched concordance. Select at most2 with oriented concordance>=0.60 and discovery95% weekly-block lower bound>0.50, at least10 matched cases, at most one activity-family feature (quote/trade count). Rank by distance from0.50. Rule cutoff is90th percentile of oriented feature over all eligible discovery hours, not cases. Freeze rules before loading replication outcomes. If none qualify, no forced rule selection.
replication: Aug1..Sep30 23UTC. Report all6 trajectory differences with discovery directions and99.1667% bootstrap intervals (6 comparisons); no direction/threshold changes. All outcomes from this calendar were previously used for other targets: temporal replication, NOT pristine confirmation.
replay: Each selected feature rule independently, plus AND of both if2. Hourly causal scanning, max3 alerts/day,24h same-coin cooldown. Target: objective onset anchor within0..6h after signal; also report stricter >=1h lead. Compare1000 same-time/count random full replays with same24h cooldown, report unfilled slots. Record event recall, median lead to onset,24h minimum low and close return. No trading-PnL claim.
inference: 10000 bootstrap draws of fixed7day calendar blocks. Show raw case/control counts, data attrition, matched medians, and event-aligned trajectories. Discovery can generate hypotheses but cannot confirm them. All numeric thresholds are research operational definitions, not universal market facts.
isolation: Do not edit previous flow_replay future protocol/code/manifest or production scanner. Any new hypotheses need their own fresh future validation.
